charts.name: E
charts.title: the card flip, height, and the row shift

A1.label: Entrance holds up to 5 cards, bottom of screen

A2.label: player picks any of the 5, any order

A5.label: NEW legal cells highlighted while a card is held

A7.label: occupied cells refuse: stacking is effect-only, debug toggle aside

A10.label: placement is one undo step, Game.save_state

A11.label: NEW scoring pass runs — chart B

A12.label: Entrance empty, or no legal move left?

A14.label: put the card back costs nothing, OK_NOOP path

A15.label: patience retired: no Next, no auto-advance

A16.label: player presses End at any time — chart D

B1.label: ANY board mutation runs a pass — arrivals and removals alike

B2.label: did this mutation only DROP cards down?

B3.label: drops never score: the mover carries an explicit flag

B4.label: NEW detector card enumerates lines through the arrival cell

B5.label: lines through the cell: row, column, diagonal, height — chart C

B8.label: NEW ScoringSection built per completed line, kind carried on the section

B10.label: Game._spotlight_section runs the beam cascade unchanged

B11.label: hand RE-EVALUATED after every spotlight effect

B12.label: Game.add_line_score banks into the line's bucket — chart D

B13.label: combo registers: first of its class +1, repeat +0.5

B14.label: on_score and on_after_score fire per line membership

B15.label: props run their full tick simulation

B16.label: did an effect complete another line?

B17.label: re-scan and score it too, same pass

B18.label: board is locked, processing = true, for the whole pass

B19.label: no line-scored memory and no within-pass guard: the runaway cap is the ONLY bound

C1.label: coordinate is 4-component: grid, x, y, height

C2.label: Entrance is row -1 of the lattice, a special case of the same type

C3.label: a line is COMPLETE when every cell in it is occupied

C6.label: diagonal: the two corner-to-corner runs, per grid, no wrapping

C7.label: height horizontal: the cards AT level h across a row or column

C8.label: height vertical: a stack of 5 in one cell

C9.label: 3-D diagonal: full family including corner-to-corner x, y and z steps

C10.label: lines never cross a grid boundary

C11.label: a taller stack still has a card at level h, so it counts

C12.label: vertical stacks score at every multiple of 5, and score the WHOLE stack

C13.label: heights 6 to 9 score nothing; 10 scores all ten

C14.label: one card can be in several lines at once, each its own hand

C15.label: grid size is a property, defaulting to 5x5

D1.label: a scored line banks into its bucket

D4.label: special-meld bucket, per grid — every diagonal and every future special meld, ONE bucket

D5.label: grid score = the PRODUCT of every bucket that HAS scored

D6.label: a bucket that has NOT scored contributes +0 — it never multiplies by 0

D7.label: has any bucket in this grid scored?

D8.label: no bucket scored: this grid contributes 0

D9.label: board total = sum of every grid score

D11.label: melds and effects both feed combo on the same terms

D12.label: HUD shows board total and combo as two numbers with an x between

D22.label: NO subtotals are displayed: no grid score, no bucket breakdown

D13.label: HUD is always live: no act, no banking moment

D14.label: End fires its hooks, then resolves — no scoring round

D16.label: win if total >= goal; fame banks the full total

E1.label: PHASE 0, owner-executed: pips to the bottom, art to the top

E3.label: done-when: new card_visual committed, test_outline green, pose signature re-derived

E4.label: CARD_SEPARATION re-derived from the BOTTOM edge, same arithmetic mirrored

E5.label: outline shader UNCHANGED: symmetric UV-space rim, no directional term

E6.label: FX mask moves with the rig: flame roots follow, by construction

E8.label: a covered card shows its BOTTOM strip, which is now its pips

E9.label: newest card at the top draws IN FRONT

E10.label: every row's cards share a BOTTOM edge

E11.label: a tall stack pushes every row ABOVE it up

E12.label: _row_open machinery reused, direction inverted, eased not snapped

E13.label: Entrance is row -1 and its own height pushes the board up the same way

E14.label: a jumping card lifts the whole stack above it, rigidly, by the full jump rise

E15.label: a springing stack OVERLAPS the rows above rather than re-flowing the board

E16.label: a hoop rides the card that actually jumped, not the stack

E17.label: height score label sits ABOVE the topmost card of its stack

E18.label: scroll anchors at the BOTTOM on entry

E19.label: the flip applies in every view: board, deck viewer, map, info card

E20.label: sheet layouts unchanged, every frame index stays valid

F1.label: 5 slots, because rules1 holds 5 entrance adder cards — one column each

F2.label: Entrance follows the camera while uncommitted, like a hand

F3.label: first placement COMMITS the batch to that grid

F4.label: commit is SILENT: no confirmation, no dimming, no marking

F5.label: the Entrance detaching and moving to that grid IS the only signal

F7.label: no legal placement left in this grid, cards still in the Entrance?

F8.label: commitment lifts and is announced; next placement re-commits

F9.label: Entrance empty OR no legal move remains?

F10.label: refill: draw from the top of the shuffled deck

F11.label: unused cards keep their slots; only empty slots fill

F12.label: refill is strictly LEFT TO RIGHT: no randomisation anywhere

F13.label: each entrance header card draws its own card, in board order

F23.label: no RNG in the refill, so the determinism ruling holds by construction

F14.label: the deck SHUFFLE at game start keeps its existing RNG, unchanged

F16.label: deck exhausted: slots stay visible and empty; End highlights

F17.label: a card leaving keeps its slot empty; nothing slides over

G1.label: meta card counts the deck at game start

G2.label: grid count = max of 1 and ceil(deck size / 52)

G5.label: meta card ADDS or SUBTRACTS persistent grid-creator cards to match

G6.label: grid creator is ZoneAdder-shaped: on_spotlight builds the 5x5

G7.label: 25 cell zone cards per grid, each a real card

G8.label: all unlocked grids exist from the first card, in one row

G10.label: 1 grid dead centre; 2 straddle the exact centre; 3 put the middle where a single grid sits

G11.label: no panel and no per-grid chrome: the gap alone defines a grid

G13.label: on_unspotlight removes the grid and discards its cards

G14.label: that grid's score labels go with it

G16.label: was the camera focused on it?

G17.label: refocus the nearest surviving grid, preferring the left

H1.label: game picture design_size sized for exactly 3 grids

H2.label: height = the board's natural height or the aspect minimum, whichever is larger

H3.label: render target CLAMPED; size_2d_override keeps the layout at full size

H4.label: the show OPENS zoomed out, on the all-grids view

H22.label: picture frame holds 3 grid positions; the camera steps between them

H5.label: all-grids view shows as many grids as fit at a readable zoom, and pans

H6.label: all-grids is orientation: clicking a grid zooms in on it

H7.label: Back zooms out a level; Forward returns to the previous view

H8.label: panning gets its OWN bindings; the wall keeps its shoulder buttons

H9.label: pan steps one grid at a time, always landing centred

H11.label: Camera2D limit and smoothing do the clamping

H12.label: clamp collapses to centre on any axis that already fits

H13.label: ONE scroll container inside the picture, for tall stacks and oversized grids

H23.label: camera pans between grid positions; the scroller reveals more of ONE grid

H24.label: with more than 3 grids, panning shifts WHICH 3 are in frame

H14.label: arrow keys move the cell selection and cross grids, panning to follow

H15.label: in all-grids view arrows select a GRID and Enter focuses it

H16.label: one-finger swipe read as ScreenDrag, emulated events filtered by device -1

H17.label: a drag starting on a card is a placement; on empty board it is a pan

H18.label: the wall camera's resting pose becomes the SAVED PAN

H19.label: leaving saves it; returning restores it, snapped to the nearest grid

H20.label: the wall re-packs around the wider picture

H21.label: Info mode fits the window-aspect view, not the whole wide picture
